purpose: Four separate transparent character head portraits; original model identities; angular painted hero-selection style

portraits.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE finished videogame character-selection HEAD PORTRAIT illustration, a single standalone square 1024x1024 RGBA PNG with a genuinely transparent background. This is an original character from the supplied reference, not a screenshot, not a character sheet. The reference is identity guidance only; do not reproduce its text, layout, weapons or full body.
Subject: BROOK, the hooded toxic assassin in the reference. Preserve his dark charcoal angular hood, glowing yellow-lime eyes in the hood's shadow, compact charcoal respirator with two round cheek filters, muted brick-red scarf at the neck, warm olive skin glimpsed around the eyes. Male adult, narrow sharp face, watchful intense expression. Keep the mask covering the mouth and nose.
Style: premium tactical hero-shooter selection portrait art, like the sharp angular painted portraits used in Valorant's agent-selection interface: bold geometric planes, controlled painterly brush shapes, sophisticated cel-shaded illustration, crisp silhouette, strong graphic shadows, restrained detail. Match the original low-poly character identity, but make polished 2D portrait art, not a literal low-poly 3D render. Subtle lime glow confined to eyes; no noisy effects.
Composition: close-up head and a small amount of neck/upper shoulders, nearly frontal with only a gentle 10-degree turn toward viewer-left, looking at viewer. Top of hood at 7% image height, eyes around 42%, lower neck/scarf ends by 94%. The head occupies roughly 70% of square width; complete hood silhouette inside canvas with 6% padding. Compact upper shoulders at bottom, no chest, arms, hands or weapons. Face must remain clearly identifiable in a 64px selection icon.
Lighting: strong clean key from upper left, sculpted dark shadows, fine restrained cool rim light. Palette charcoal, muted brick red, olive skin, bright lime eyes. Background fully alpha-transparent with clean antialiased edges, no card, no frame, no circle, no gradient plate, no fake checkerboard, no shadow outside silhouette.
No text, letters, name, logos, watermark, UI, border, extra heads, alternate views, props, or scenery.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: standalone hero-selection head portrait for a videogame, 1:1 square RGBA PNG, genuinely transparent background.
Input image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY reference. Input image 2 is the finished BROOK portrait from the same set and is STYLE/COMPOSITION reference only: match its angular painted shadow planes, rendering quality, clear cutout silhouette, close framing, clean restrained lighting, eye-level camera and vivid eyes. Do not copy its hood, scarf or gas-mask design onto a character who does not have them.
Make ONE original portrait, not a sheet. Premium tactical hero-shooter portrait illustration, the graphic angular painted/cel-shaded art language of Valorant agent selection. Broad intentional color planes, sharp edges, minimal micro-detail, mature expressive character design, polished hand-painted illustration rather than photorealism. Extremely readable at 64 pixels.
Tight head and neck with only a little upper shoulder clothing at the bottom. Complete hair/head silhouette within the canvas, about 6% margin, no full torso. Nearly frontal with a gentle 10-degree turn toward viewer-left, eyes engaging the viewer. Strong upper-left key, controlled cool rim, sculpted shadows. Head large and centered, about 80% image height. No scenery, no text, no letters, no names, logos, watermark, border, circle, UI panel, gradient background, card, fake checkerboard, hands, weapons, extra people or decorative effects. Preserve actual alpha transparency with clean antialiased edges.
Subject: VENA, the bald muscular chempunk tank from identity reference 1. Preserve the angular bald warm tan head with a small vertical forehead scar, thick dark furrowed eyebrows, narrowed glowing acidic lime eyes, broad powerful jaw and imposing adult male face proportions. The lower half of his face is covered by a heavy charcoal industrial respirator, angular armored nose bridge, two large round side filter housings with recognizable vertical lime-green vent slits. Only the tops of dark armored shoulder straps and a short hint of neon-green breathing hose at the collar are visible; no backpack cylinder in frame. Face and mask occupy most of portrait. Intimidating composed scowl. Palette: warm tan skin, charcoal and muted bronze armor, vivid lime filter lights and eyes. Render the full scalp, no hood, no hair, no beard. Keep the exact tank identity, no extra face armor.

Subject: the PLAGUE GHOUL, the skeletal toxic undead character from identity reference 1. This is the fourth previously modeled character. Preserve its aged pale beige elongated skull, high cracked cranium with a distinctive black vertical fracture on the forehead, skeletal cheekbones and narrow black triangular nose cavity, glowing acid-lime eyeballs recessed into large dark eye sockets. Its mouth is open in a menacing sneer with irregular pointed teeth and a little vivid lime poisonous drool hanging from the lower jaw. Unmistakably an undead SKULL, no skin nose, no fleshy ears, no hair, no mask, no hood. Thin olive-beige skeletal neck, a small hint of ragged dark brick-red collar/shoulders at the bottom, one or two lime growths at the shoulder edge only if room. Skull dominates the portrait. Stylized fantasy enemy, clean non-gory graphic design, no blood or wounds. Palette: warm aged bone beige, dark socket shadows, muted brick red, bright lime eyes and restrained slime. Keep complete crown, jaw, and drool inside the frame.
